subject: CPPO: ResellCo activation sequencing & evidence packaging (APAC pilot)
body:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@resellco.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Li <alex@resellco.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: CPPO activation for APAC pilot - sequencing and asks

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. We're lining up a small APAC pilot (Singapore + Sydney) and want to get the Channel Partner Private Offer path in motion. High level asks:

- Activation sequencing we should follow (Marketplace listing -> Private Offer -> Entitlement provisioning -> Billing routing)
- Evidence checklist your team will need for CPPO approval (SOC/Security artifacts, MPA draft, reseller entity docs)
- Any region-specific gotchas for APAC (tax/VAT, entity mapping)

We're targeting early September to accept the private offer so timeline is tight. I've looped Alex (ops) to gather docs on our side.

Can you confirm next steps and if Redwood can own the docpack packaging for the AWS review?

Thanks,
Sanjay
Sanjay Patel
Head of Partnerships, ResellCo
[attachment: resellco_entity_cert.pdf (pdf)]

-----
On Fri, 14 Aug 2026 at 11:13 AM Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com> wrote:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@resellco.com>
Cc: Alex Li <alex@resellco.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 11:13:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CPPO activation for APAC pilot - sequencing and asks

Thanks Sanjay — good plan. Below is a concise activation sequence and the artifacts we need. I've attached a starter evidence checklist and a proposed invoice-routing matrix for your finance team to review.

Proposed activation sequence (short):
1) Confirm reseller legal entity + billing PO (you)
2) Redwood prepares evidence package and MPA draft (we)
3) Submit CPPO with AWS partner ops; AWS reviews (AWS)
4) Reseller accepts private offer and we provision entitlements (Redwood + ResellCo)
5) Invoice routing and metering go live (billing sync)

Required artifacts (attached):
- Corporate/Entity docs (W-8/W-9 equivalents for APAC)
- SOC2 summary + data flow diagram (high level)
- MPA draft (we've included a version to start)
- Support & data retention SLA summary

Attachments included: resellco_evidence_checklist.pdf, resellco_mpa_draft-20260814.docx, invoice_routing_matrix.xlsx

Open questions for you:
- Which entity will receive the invoice in each market? (SG / AU)
- Any reseller-side tax/VAT registrations we should account for?

Action items:
- Alex: share entity certificates and confirmation of billing entities (ASAP)
- Ben (cc'd): can you review the MPA draft and flag any Redwood ops or billing items we should change for APAC?

I can own submission to AWS once we have the package. Target: submit by Aug 21 to keep the early September acceptance window.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Channel Sales | Redwood Inference

-----
On Sat, 15 Aug 2026 at 08:40 AM Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com> wrote:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay@resellco.com>
Cc: Alex Li <alex@resellco.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CPPO activation for APAC pilot - sequencing and asks

Thanks Neha. Quick notes from billing/entitlement perspective:

- Entitlement mapping: we need a matrix mapping ResellCo SKU -> Redwood SKU -> Marketplace SKU. Alex, can you share the current SKU list?
- Billing split: invoice_routing_matrix.xlsx is a good start; we need to confirm the pay-to entity for each market (SG = ResellCo Asia Pte Ltd?, AU = ResellCo Pty Ltd?). Once confirmed, we set the invoice recipients in the CPPO metadata.
- Tax: for SG, if invoices go to an entity registered for GST, we need the registration number on file.

DocuSign: we'll need a signed MPA before we finish the CPPO submission packet. Neha, recommend we use the attached MPA draft as the source and route to legal for a quick e-sign.

I'll prepare the entitlement template and drop it in the Drive link (will add to HS-Deal-12345).

- Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Partner Ops | Redwood Inference

-----
On Tue, 18 Aug 2026 at 15:03 PM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@resellco.com>, Alex Li <alex@resellco.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CPPO activation for APAC pilot - sequencing and asks

Nice thread — thanks, team. Quick internal alignment and owners: 

- Neha: own CPPO submission to AWS. Target submit date: 2026-08-21 EOD.
- Ben: finalize entitlement matrix and confirm invoice pay-to entities by EOD 8/19.
- Vanessa: please prep Marketplace ops checklist and confirm any region-specific listing metadata (tax id fields, pricing tiers) by 8/20.
- Alex / ResellCo: provide entity docs + GST/VAT ids by 8/19.

Marissa: I will triage any legal redlines after the MPA comes back signed and escalate to execs if we need credit/term exceptions. If AWS asks for evidence, Redwood will own packaging and upload to the designated portal.

Next steps (client-facing):
- Sanjay: once you confirm entities, I'll schedule a 30-min handoff with Marketplace ops and provide the CPPO packet preview.

Thanks — this keeps us on the early September goal.

Marissa Cole
Head of Channel Partnerships | Redwood Inference
